fee_structure: ₹100/- (Registration Fee), ₹100/- (Counselling Late Fee - 1st Week), ₹100 + ₹100 per day (Counselling Late Fee - 2nd Week)
selection_stages: Display of applicant list and eligible candidate list
Release of 1st Merit List (Provisional, then Final)
Fee payment by candidates allotted a seat in the 1st list
Release of 2nd Merit List (Provisional, then Final) for remaining/leftover seats
Fee payment by candidates allotted a seat in the 2nd list
Physical counselling for any leftover seats after the 2nd list
